memory_citations: The customer chose an independent small business instead of a large marketplace.
The owner wants the message to feel handmade, specific, and grateful rather than promotional.
CustomCard UX requires four editable panels, print-safe margins, human review before external sharing, and exportable/persisted render artifacts.

images.revised_prompt: Generate only the FRONT COVER artwork for a portrait 5x7 folded greeting card panel. This is one standalone print panel, not a folded-card preview and not a collage. Target final composition is 1500 x 2100 px at 300 DPI; keep important content inside safe margins. Recipient: loyal customers. Relationship: small business to repeat customer. Occasion: thank-you for supporting a small business. Tone: warm, sincere, polished, grateful, not salesy. Style: CustomCard small-business editorial: warm citrus, soft cream, deep charcoal, local shop texture, clean 5x7 portrait layout, generous safe margins, editable typography overlays.
